Getting such clocks to work, however, proved no easy feat, because driving these narrow nuclear transitions requires highly stable lasers with extremely small bandwidths.

Their results set limits on how dark matter can couple to photons and the strong nuclear force that are comparable to those derived from today’s best atomic clocks.

He is also interested in creating a trapped-ion thorium nuclear clock that would be more isolated from its environment and could re-use many of the quantum control techniques developed for atomic and ion clocks.
Victor Flambaum , a theorist from the University of New South Wales, Australia who was not involved in either project, calls the teams’ devices the “first prototypes of nuclear clocks”.

chapters.title: France fires upgraded nuclear-capable missile from submarine for first time
chapters.angle: 追踪本次报道中的具体变化

blocks.text: PARIS — France test-fired an upgraded version of its M51 strategic ballistic missile from a submarine for the first time on Tuesday, a capability demonstration that President Emmanuel Macron called “very important” for the country’s strategic credibility and which he said would be monitored by allies and adversaries alike.

displayTranslation.text: 巴黎——法国周二首次从潜艇试射了一枚升级版M51战略弹道导弹，总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙称这是一次对该国战略可信度“非常重要”的能力展示，并表示盟友和对手都会加以关注。
displayTranslation.sourceText: PARIS — France test-fired an upgraded version of its M51 strategic ballistic missile from a submarine for the first time on Tuesday, a capability demonstration that President Emmanuel Macron called “very important” for the country’s strategic credibility and which he said would be monitored by allies and adversaries alike.

blocks.text: Today’s launch was the seventh time a variant of the M51 was fired from a French submarine, and the 13th launch of the missile overall, all of them “of course, conducted without a nuclear warhead,” according to the ministry.

displayTranslation.text: 据国防部称，此次发射是M51的某个型号第七次从法国潜艇上发射，也是该导弹整体第13次发射，所有这些发射“当然都是在不携带核弹头的情况下进行的”。

blocks.text: The nuclear-powered ballistic-missile submarine Le Vigilant fired an M51.3 missile in an acceptance test following the boat’s overhaul, the Ministry of the Armed Forces said in a statement.

displayTranslation.text: 法国武装部在一份声明中说，核动力弹道导弹潜艇“警惕号”在该艇大修后进行的一次验收测试中发射了一枚M51.3导弹。
displayTranslation.sourceText: The nuclear-powered ballistic-missile submarine Le Vigilant fired an M51.3 missile in an acceptance test following the boat’s overhaul, the Ministry of the Armed Forces said in a statement.

blocks.text: The missile, which didn’t carry a nuclear warhead, was launched off Finistère in western France and splashed down in the North Atlantic several hundred kilometers from any coastline, the ministry said.

displayTranslation.text: 国防部称，这枚未携带核弹头的导弹在法国西部菲尼斯泰尔附近海域发射，并溅落在北大西洋，距任何海岸线都有数百公里。
